verdict.rationale: Highnote's Spend Rules explicitly support MCC-based logic evaluated at authorization time, and rules can be scoped per card, account, or program (including single-card/single-merchant-like restriction via card-level rules). However, the evidence does not explicitly confirm an MCC allowlist/blocklist distinction or a dedicated 'single-merchant lock' feature—only general merchant category restriction and per-transaction/velocity caps. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of MCC allowlist vs blocklist configuration and a named single-merchant lock capability.
